name: Achievement — Unlocked
description: Compact upper-right achievement notification over transparent footage. The card deliberately enters and clears through the same right edge because this is notification behavior; at the authored focal beat the flat hex medal lands as the sole hero and the yellow chip pops slightly late while the title remains stable. Syntax channel chrome resolves entirely through achievement.* Pack Roles. Torn edge and registration jitter are intentionally omitted because this is clean printed chrome, not a quoted substrate or hand mark; grit is intentionally omitted because this is a transparent live Overlay. No zine treatment, gradient, glow, gaussian shadow, glossy sweep, or opaque composition background.
